name: GRIDBURN: AR Street Domination Circuit
description: One of the earliest citywide AR territory games in GLMZ, GRIDBURN overlays a capture-the-node network across real city infrastructure — transit hubs, power relay stations, water reclamation points — that players physically travel to and 'burn' for their faction using BCI-synced gestures and proximity authentication. Factions are neighborhood-based, and a single node held for 48 hours generates real Φ micropayments funded by the game's corporate backer, Strukturen AG. The Shelf districts turned GRIDBURN into a genuine economic hustle, with teams running 24-hour node rotations.
story_hooks: A GRIDBURN faction discovers that one of their contested nodes sits atop an undocumented Strukturen AG data relay, and holding it gives them access to corporate logistics feeds.
Two rival Shelf factions agree to a temporary truce to dominate the city's entire northern grid — and attract the attention of someone who doesn't want that coordination happening.
A Tier 3 player infiltrates a Shelf faction to study the game's economic dynamics and falls in genuinely with the community they were sent to exploit.
